content: Mike Flanagan’s latest Stephen King adaptation, Carrie (this will be his fourth), is slated to make its debut on Amazon Prime on October 7th. The new trailer dropped at Comic-Con 2026 and doesn’t contain many surprises. If you’re familiar with Carrie at all, it hits all the expected notes. Though it’s clearly been updated for the modern era. According to Deadline, Flanagan’s take on the classic King novel will tackle very modern teen challenges like active shooter drills and bullying on social media. The director apparently invited high schoolers into the writers’ room, using their real-life traumas to inform the script: > “They shared shocking one-off situations or constant treatment and microaggressions and things that are not necessarily present themselves as targeted harassment. [We will dive into] the cruelty in today’s world and how the internet has encouraged cruelty, rewards and celebrates and amplifies it. This is awful for adults to deal with, and for teenagers even more so.” [Media: https://youtu.be/NJTf5CIAcjc] Brian De Palma’s iconic 1976 adaptation of Carrie is iconic and features an unimpeachable performance from Sissy Spacek. But it’s undeniable that Summer H. Howell, who was 21 at the time of shooting, is much more believable as a high school student than Spacek, who was 26 at the time.

chineseContent: 迈克·弗拉纳根 (Mike Flanagan) 最新改编的斯蒂芬·金 (Stephen King) 作品《魔女嘉莉》(Carrie)（这将是他的第四部作品）预计将于 10 月 7 日在 Amazon Prime 上首映。新预告片在 2026 年动漫展上发布，并没有带来太多惊喜。如果你对《嘉莉》很熟悉，那么它符合你所有的预期。尽管它显然已经针对现代进行了更新。据 Deadline 报道，弗拉纳根对经典金小说的诠释将解决非常现代的青少年挑战，例如活跃的射击训练和社交媒体上的欺凌行为。导演显然邀请了高中生进入编剧室，利用他们现实生活中的创伤来为剧本提供信息：>“他们分享了令人震惊的一次性情况或持续的待遇和微侵犯，以及不一定将自己视为有针对性的骚扰的事情。[我们将深入探讨]当今世界的残酷行为，以及互联网如何鼓励、奖励、庆祝和放大残酷行为。这对成年人来说是可怕的，对青少年来说更是如此。” [媒体：https://youtu.be/NJTf5CIAcjc] 布莱恩·德·帕尔马 (Brian De Palma) 于 1976 年改编的经典电影《魔女嘉莉》(Carrie) 具有标志性意义，其中茜茜·斯派塞克 (Sissy Spacek) 的表演无可挑剔。但不可否认的是，拍摄时 21 岁的萨默·H·豪威尔 (S​​ummer H. Howell) 作为一名高中生比当时 26 岁的斯派塞克 (Spacek) 更可信。
